text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Trainer-kun!
The day of the glorious festival has finally arrived!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"The Japanese Derby.
Otherwise known as—the 'Tokyo Yushun.'"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A packed house, with a live orchestra performance.
And the performers are all rising stars defining this year!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yet all of them exist solely to serve me
and make me shine all the brighter!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, young "Conqueror", forever!

As expected of the Derby, tension is high right from the start.
I follow alongside her to the paddock.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ayabe-san.
So you've advanced your piece as well, I see.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
How about it? On this memorable day—
before the race begins, shall we link arms
and sing at the top of our lungs?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I won't sing. I won't let you set the pace.
And besides...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I won't blame you anymore.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: My fault? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"‘Satsuki Sho’...
I... wasn't able to shoulder it all."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Deep down, I was playing the victim...
That's why I couldn't run it through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'll face myself...
properly, and head-on.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I run because I want to run. By my own will, in this Derby.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...
I get it... So that was your intention.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you really are just the kind of Umamusume I thought you'd be.
Wouldn't you say so, Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

She gives a forced, awkward laugh...
Unable to quite grasp
what Admire Vega is feeling.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, if you're motivated, that's great!
That's my rival for you, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let us see your power!
Are you merely a supporting player, or—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Will you join forces with me from here on,
becoming a comrade who fights the older generation alongside me?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Today's opera has no script!
Everything depends on our running—yours and mine.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, onward to conquest!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san is different from before.
At first, she hated talking to Opera O-san so much...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'll answer properly, with pride...
It's going to be... an incredible race...
